parameters.question: Compare two CRISPR gRNA design tables for human FOXP3 (20nt guides, NGG PAM, both strands, GC 20-80%, no homopolymer runs of 4+). Align rows by the (target_sequence, pam_sequence) pair. Every target_sequence in one file must appear in the other with the same pam_sequence, with no extra or missing pairs. Row order, column order, and extra columns (e.g., strand, position, GC content) may differ and must not be penalized. Sequence comparison is case-insensitive.
